verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows, such as recurring agent purchases or scheduled payment jobs, is a plausible axis for an agentic-payments platform, so the story applies. The evidence documents only one-off purchase-intent mandates with an expiry time (effectiveUntilTime) and real-time post-purchase triggers. Neither is a recurring schedule, and no cron, recurrence or scheduled-workflow capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
